تستقطرون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْطِرُونَ (tastaqṭirūna) /tas.taq.tˤi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# تُسْتَقْطَرُونَ (tustaqṭarūna) /tus.taq.tˤa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
